argv:
Apply the approved Public interface declaration to the architecture working copy, and
any change it makes to a named document to that document's working copy. Do not edit any
other file, including the Registry, product, tests or step definitions. Read each working
copy and replace the exact text the fix provides.

Service: greeter
Approved fix:
Edit only the working copy of the architecture document `docs/architecture/architecture.yaml`. Do not touch `docs/scenarios.yaml`, `docs/product/product.yaml`, `docs/greeter-cli.yaml`, or any other file.

The System Architect answered:
- interface-kind: `cli` — a command-line interface declared in an OpenCLI-like document.
- interface-document: `docs/greeter-cli.yaml` — the existing OpenCLI document (it exists at the Host project root and already declares `commands.greet` plus `extensions.files.greeting-config`, `extensions.log_records.greeted`, and `extensions.outgoing_calls.notify`).
- document-completeness: complete as written — name it from the architecture document unchanged, so `docs/greeter-cli.yaml` needs NO edit.
- ui-elements: not applicable — greeter offers no user interface, so declare no `elements`.

Make exactly one edit, adding `public_interface` to the `greeter` entry in `architecture.services` and changing nothing else (leave the existing line-1 comment, `name`, `path`, and `language` exactly as they are).

File: docs/architecture/architecture.yaml

old_string:
```
  - name: greeter
    path: services/greeter
    language: go
```

new_string:
```
  - name: greeter
    path: services/greeter
    language: go
    public_interface:
      kind: cli
      document: docs/greeter-cli.yaml
```

Notes for the applier:
- Indentation is two spaces per level; `public_interface` sits at the same indent as `name`/`path`/`language` (four spaces), and its `kind`/`document` keys at six spaces.
- `kind` must be the literal string `cli`; `document` must be the project-root-relative path `docs/greeter-cli.yaml`, exactly as the Architect named it.
- Do not add an `elements` list — that key belongs to `ui` interfaces only, and greeter offers no user interface.
- Do not add, remove, or reorder any other key in the document, and do not create or modify any interface document.
Architecture working copy:

Edit `tmp/{{RUN_DIR}}/architecture_yaml.yaml`, the working copy of `./docs/architecture/architecture.yaml`.
